answer_2.quote: As human evaluation is generally not well suited to assess diversity , we automatically measure diversity by comparing distributions of generated and existing poems along formal, semantic and stylistic dimensions.

answer_4.quote: To investigate whether this is the case, we conducted a small-scale human evaluation of the overall quality of quatrains, focusing specifically on coherence and semantics (punctuation was omitted here, as it was also excluded during the diversity evaluation).
